title: LINEAGE: A Benchmark for Empirical Lineage Retrieval in AI Scientific Literature
abstract: arXiv:2611.25845v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current research agents are moving beyond academic search toward literature synthesis and experiment planning. These workflows increasingly rely on literature retrieval systems, which serve as standalone systems or as components of research agents. However, existing scientific literature retrieval benchmarks mainly evaluate these methods using topical relevance or citation links as supervision, which cannot capture which prior methods are used for empirical comparison. To address this gap, we introduce Lineage, a benchmark for empirical lineage retrieval in AI scientific literature. An empirical lineage relation links a prior paper to a source paper that explicitly uses its method as an empirical comparison baseline. These relations form lineage graphs whose multi-hop neighborhoods provide retrieval ground truth for structural evaluation. translated_title: LINEAGE：AI科学文献中实证谱系检索的基准
translated_abstract: 当前的研究智能体正从单纯的学术搜索迈向文献综合与实验规划。这些工作流日益依赖文献检索系统，检索系统既可以作为独立系统运行，也可以作为研究智能体的组成部分。然而，现有的科学文献检索基准主要使用主题相关性或引用链接作为监督信号来评估这些方法，无法捕捉哪些先前的方法被用作实证比较。为填补这一空白，我们提出了Lineage，一个面向AI科学文献中实证谱系检索的基准。实证谱系关系将一篇先前论文与一篇明确将其方法用作实证比较基线的源论文关联起来。这些关系构成谱系图，其多跳邻域为结构性评估提供了检索真值。为了大规模构建这些图谱，我们开发了Lineage-Constructor，它将异构的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了Lineage基准，用于在AI科学文献中检索实证谱系关系（即先前论文的方法被后续论文明确用作实证比较基线），并开发了Lineage-Constructor工具来大规模构建谱系图，为结构性检索评估提供真值。
en_tdlr: We introduce LINEAGE, a benchmark for retrieving empirical lineage relations in AI scientific literature—where a prior paper's method is explicitly used as an empirical comparison baseline—along with Lineage-Constructor, a tool for building lineage graphs at scale to provide ground truth for structural retrieval evaluation.
